text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins today! I'm eager to begin training in preparation for the Kikuka Sho, the last race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, after arriving at the lodge, Admire Vega seems sidetracked with something.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey… You haven't seen Shinko Windy, have you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Really? Ugh… Where did she wander off to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabeee!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I found Windy! Thanks for your help!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr… What're ya looking for me fooor?! Leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haha, how am I supposed to do that when we're classmates?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Look, they're doing roll call over there. You only need to hang around a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Well… if you say so…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh… All right, now that you've found Windy, I'll be—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ayabe! Ticket just found Taishin and is bringing her back to our class's line.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket found her resting in a corner. She was feeling sick after getting off the bus and being surrounded by all the other students. Sorry for all the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine if you found her. That sounds like everyone, then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road! I can handle the roll call.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All right… Thanks for the report, Class Representative.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sorry for leaving you in charge of all these troublemakers. As your classmate, I should have helped you with the responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! You're managing the entire student council, Air Groove. Leave the classes to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And actually, I got a lot of help from Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If we don't finish roll call, we can't start getting ready for training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I knew I could count on you! You're such a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. You don't have to say all that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching Admire Vega around her classmates, she seems like a different person from the taciturn, training-focused Umamusume I'm used to.
